result.title: Test-Time Latent Computation to Improve Visual Perception in Multimodal Large Language Models
result.summary: Recent work on Large Language Models (LLMs) suggests that reasoning capabilities can be enhanced at test time not only through longer token-level reasoning traces, but also through additional computation in latent space. This raises a natural question for Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs): can additional computation in latent space improve visual perception at test time? In this work, we first verify that MLLMs contain stable reusable layers that can be re-forwarded at inference time without disrupting normal generation. Based on this observation, we propose \textbf{Lo}ok \textbf{Ba}ck in the \textbf{L}atent \textbf{S}pace (\textbf{Lobals}), a training-free decoding method that identifies the contiguous layer window with the strongest visual-token attention and re-forwards through it, allowing the model to revisit visual evidence in latent space. We demonstrate that this latent-space revisit strategy can improve MLLMs' performance across diverse multimodal settings, including general vision-language tasks, visual hallucination tasks, and vision-centric tasks.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文探讨 MLLM 能否在测试时通过 latent 空间额外计算改善视觉感知，先验证存在可稳定复用的层，再提出免训练的 Lobals 解码方法：定位视觉 token 注意力最强的连续层窗口并重复前向，让模型在 latent 空间重新访问视觉证据，并在通用视觉语言、幻觉与视觉中心任务上评测。
AI.relevance_reason: 直接对应测试时 latent 计算与 LOOK 式视觉证据再访问，并涉及循环层选择与额外计算成本，可供核查重复层深度对 latent 表示与视觉信息保真度的影响、以及其收益是否真来自视觉证据使用。
